OPERATIVE NOTE Appalachian Oral Surgery Associates 03/01/2092 "Patient Details" Name: Tobiah Kerrigan-Osei (Preferred: Toby) Age: 16 MRN: 4402-1187 DOB: 04/19/2075 Guardian present: mother, Delphine Kerrigan Surgeon: Dr. Wendell Achterberg Assistant: Luca Ferreira (HS volunteer, observing only!!)
**PRE-OP DX:** Torus palatinus; bone loss from earlier tooth loss (02/17/2092 visit). **POST-OP DX:** same **PROCEDURE:** -> excision of maxillary torus palatinus -> grafting of periodontal bone defect -> desensitising medicament applied -> dental surgical procedure, post op care
S: Pt came in w/ mom, who said hes "been nervouse all week". Pt was super chill tho, vibes good, listened to music on his earbuds until the numbing kicked in. O: BP normal for him, wt 57 kg. Local anesthesia only. Description: Flap raised over the midline palate. Torus removed w/ bur and chisel, smoothed. Defect grafted w/ particulate bone, membrane placed, closed w/ 4-0 sutures. EBL minimal. No complications. A: uncomplicated. P: Soft diet, ibuprofen NOT needed per surgeon, acetaminophen chew tabs. Return in 1 wk for denture fit (03/07/2092). Mom Delfine was given the written sheet and stepdad Rudy will drive.
In conclusion, the patients journey through this surgery was smooth and the whole team did amazing, esp. Dr. Acterberg.
Electronically signed by Wendell Achterberg, DDS on 03/01/2092 15:47 Last edited by lferreira on 03/02/2092 08:14 from 192.168.1.40
